title: Beyond Coverage and Mutation: A Blind-Spot Analysis of LLM-Generated Unit Tests
title_zh: 超越覆盖率和变异测试：LLM生成单元测试的盲点分析

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluation protocols for LLM-generated unit tests rely on aggregate metrics such as branch coverage and mutation score. These metrics quantify the extent to which a test suite exercises program behavior, but do not identify the behavioral obligations it systematically leaves unchecked. We propose BlindSpotEval , an obligation-based evaluation framework aligned with the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern. The framework comprises three metrics, Boundary-Value Adequacy, Control-Flow Adequacy, and Oracle Strength, complemented by an assessment of execution reliability. We also introduce ObligBench , a complexity-stratified Java benchmark comprising 895 complex and 700 low-complexity functions with source-side obligation annotations. Applied to 14,320 tests generated by four LLMs under four prompting strategies, BlindSpotEval reveals systematic blind spots that aggregate metrics do not distinguish. Before adequacy scoring, 19.7% of tests fail to execute successfully, with failures ranging from compilation errors to runtime exceptions. Among test failures, 15.6% involve incorrect assertions, termed wrong-oracle failures. Such tests can contribute to code coverage despite failing, illustrating that coverage alone does not establish oracle correctness. Among executable tests, LLMs readily cover directly inferable boundary cases but struggle with non-inferable ones. Coverage of null , negative , and empty arguments reaches only 34.8%, 23.8%, and 38.8%, compared with average coverage above 93% for booleans. Exceptional control flow exhibits a similar pattern.Exceptional and fallback behavior is weakly checked, with CFA scores of 0.100 for catch blocks and 0.312 for default groups. Across both dimensions, LLM-generated tests exhibit the happy-path bias observed in human-written tests, concentrating on normal inputs and expected flows while leaving unusual values and exceptional paths unchecked. Oracle strength is high on average but uneven, with weaker assertions for object return property values and exceptions. These blind spots also occur in low-complexity functions, suggesting that code complexity alone does not explain them. BlindSpotEval provides construct-level adequacy profiles that identify under-tested obligation types and can guide targeted improvements beyond those supported by aggregate scores alone.

paragraphs.en: Software testing is fundamental to software quality, it provides a primary mechanism for developers to assess whether code behaves as intended and whether changes introduce regressions ( Ammann and Offutt, 2016 ; Myers et al., 2011 ) . As large language models (LLMs) increasingly support code generation and modification ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , automated unit test generation has become correspondingly important. Research on LLM-based test generation has advanced rapidly, producing a range of approaches. Zero-shot prompting generates tests directly from the function signature and body ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Schäfer et al., 2024 ; Siddiq et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , feedback-based approaches iteratively refine tests using coverage or mutation signals ( CodiumAI, 2024 ; Dakhel et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) , and planning-based approaches first reason about the function’s intent ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . Recent tools regularly produce tests that compile, run, and achieve high branch coverage and competitive mutation scores ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 软件测试是软件质量的基础，它为开发者提供了评估代码是否按预期运行以及变更是否引入回归的主要机制（Ammann and Offutt, 2016；Myers et al., 2011）。 随着大语言模型（LLM）日益广泛地支持代码生成与修改（Chen et al., 2021），自动化单元测试生成也变得愈发重要。 基于 LLM 的测试生成研究进展迅速，产生了一系列方法。 零样本提示直接从函数签名和函数体生成测试（Chen et al., 2024；Schäfer et al., 2024；Siddiq et al., 2024；Tang et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2024），基于反馈的方法利用覆盖率或变异信号迭代改进测试（CodiumAI, 2024；Dakhel et al., 2024；Yuan et al., 2024），而基于规划的方法则首先对函数的意图进行推理（Gu et al., 2026）。 近期的工具通常能够生成可编译、可运行，并达到高分支覆盖率和有竞争力的变异分数的测试（Jain et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: High aggregate scores, however, do not necessarily indicate thorough testing. Prior work commonly evaluates LLM-generated tests using branch coverage, which measures the proportion of program branches executed ( Zhu et al., 1997 ; Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ) , and mutation score, which measures the proportion of artificially injected faults detected ( Jia and Harman, 2011 ; Coles et al., 2016 ) . A replicability study found that these metrics correlate with fault detection only under restricted conditions ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Although useful for summarizing test effectiveness, these metrics do not directly identify which obligations remain unchecked. For example, tests using only ordinary inputs may achieve the same line coverage as tests that also check boundary values whenever those inputs traverse the same statements. Similarly, a high mutation score indicates sensitivity to injected changes without necessarily establishing whether tests adequately check particular input boundaries, exceptional paths, or behavioral properties. These distinctions have practical consequences. Omitting null inputs may leave null-handling faults undetected, failing to exercise exception handlers may leave exception-swallowing behavior unchecked, and weak assertions may allow incorrect results to pass unnoticed. Scores of 90% mutation adequacy and 80% branch coverage alone do not establish whether null inputs, exception paths, or object-state invariants have been adequately tested.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，较高的聚合分数并不一定表明测试是全面的。 先前的工作通常使用分支覆盖率来评估大语言模型生成的测试，分支覆盖率衡量程序中被执行的分支比例（Zhu et al., 1997；Fraser and Arcuri, 2011），并使用变异分数来衡量被检测出的人工注入缺陷的比例（Jia and Harman, 2011；Coles et al., 2016）。 一项可复现性研究发现，这些指标仅在受限条件下才与缺陷检测相关（Zhao et al., 2026）。 尽管这些指标有助于概括测试的有效性，但它们并不能直接识别出哪些义务仍未被检查。 例如，仅使用普通输入的测试，与那些同时检查边界值的测试，只要这些输入经过相同的语句，就可能达到相同的行覆盖率。 同样，高变异分数表明对注入变更的敏感性，但不一定能确定测试是否充分地检查了特定的输入边界、异常路径或行为属性。 这些区别具有实际的影响。 遗漏空输入可能使空值处理缺陷未被检测到，未能执行异常处理器可能使吞异常的行为未被检查，而弱断言可能让错误的结果 unnoticed 地通过。 仅凭 90% 的变异充分性和 80% 的分支覆盖率分数，并不能确定空输入、异常路径或对象状态不变式是否已得到充分测试。

paragraphs.en: Unit tests are commonly structured according to the Arrange-Act-Assert (AAA) pattern ( Osherove, 2014 ; Meszaros, 2007 ) . The Arrange phase prepares the inputs, the Act phase invokes the function, and the Assert phase verifies the resulting behavior. This structure suggests three complementary evaluation dimensions, (1) tests should cover relevant input boundary values during Arrange; (2) tests should exercise relevant control-flow alternatives during Act; and (3) tests should verify the resulting behavior through their assertions. We refer to the behaviors that tests should exercise or verify, as identified from a function’s implementation, as obligations . Our aim is to identify systematic blind spots in how LLM-generated tests satisfy these obligations.
paragraphs.zh: 单元测试通常按照「准备-执行-断言」（AAA）模式来组织结构（Osherove, 2014；Meszaros, 2007）。 准备阶段准备输入，执行阶段调用函数，断言阶段验证所产生的行为。 这一结构提示了三个互补的评估维度：(1) 测试应在准备阶段覆盖相关的输入边界值；(2) 测试应在执行阶段执行相关的控制流分支；以及 (3) 测试应通过其断言验证所产生的行为。 我们把从函数实现中识别出的、测试应当执行或验证的行为称为「义务」（obligations）。 我们的目标是识别大语言模型生成的测试在满足这些义务方面存在的系统性盲点。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches primarily assess generated tests through aggregate metrics. CoverAgent ( CodiumAI, 2024 ) seeks to maximize branch coverage but provides no construct-level diagnosis of what remains unchecked; MuTAP ( Dakhel et al., 2024 ) and ChatTester ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) use mutation feedback to improve tests, with aggregate mutation scores serving as an evaluation measure. To the best of our knowledge, no existing framework jointly assesses LLM-generated tests at the obligation level across all three AAA dimensions. We propose BlindSpotEval , an obligation-based evaluation framework aligned with the AAA pattern ( Osherove, 2014 ; Meszaros, 2007 ) . For each function under test, the framework assesses which input boundaries, control-flow alternatives, and behavioral properties the generated tests exercise or verify.

sents.zh: CoverAgent（CodiumAI, 2024）力求最大化分支覆盖率，但无法提供针对哪些内容未被覆盖的构造级诊断；MuTAP（Dakhel et al., 2024）和 ChatTester（Yuan et al., 2024）利用变异反馈来改进测试，并将聚合变异分数作为评估度量。

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, no existing framework jointly assesses LLM-generated tests at the obligation level across all three AAA dimensions.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，目前尚无现有框架能够在所有三个 AAA 维度上以义务级别联合评估大语言模型生成的测试。

sents.en: We propose BlindSpotEval , an obligation-based evaluation framework aligned with the AAA pattern ( Osherove, 2014 ; Meszaros, 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 我们提出 BlindSpotEval，这是一个与 AAA 模式（Osherove, 2014；Meszaros, 2007）相一致的基于义务的评估框架。

sents.en: For each function under test, the framework assesses which input boundaries, control-flow alternatives, and behavioral properties the generated tests exercise or verify.
sents.zh: 对于每个被测函数，该框架会评估生成的测试执行或验证了哪些输入边界、控制流分支以及行为属性。

paragraphs.en: Before assessing adequacy, we examine execution reliability through the following research question:
paragraphs.zh: 在评估充分性之前，我们通过以下研究问题来检验执行的可靠性：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Executability). To what extent do LLMs generate compilable and runnable tests, and what are the common failure modes? We measure execution success across multiple LLMs and prompting strategies and characterize failure modes to distinguish execution failures from adequacy gaps.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（可执行性）。 大语言模型在多大程度上能生成可编译且可运行的测试？常见的失败模式有哪些？ 我们衡量了多个大语言模型和提示策略下的执行成功率，并刻画失败模式，以区分执行失败与充分性不足。

sents.en: RQ1 (Executability).
sents.zh: RQ1（可执行性）。

sents.en: To what extent do LLMs generate compilable and runnable tests, and what are the common failure modes?
sents.zh: 大语言模型在多大程度上能生成可编译且可运行的测试？常见的失败模式有哪些？

sents.en: We measure execution success across multiple LLMs and prompting strategies and characterize failure modes to distinguish execution failures from adequacy gaps.
sents.zh: 我们衡量了多个大语言模型和提示策略下的执行成功率，并刻画失败模式，以区分执行失败与充分性不足。

paragraphs.en: For tests that compile and execute successfully, we then investigate three dimensions of adequacy.
paragraphs.zh: 对于能够成功编译和执行的测试，我们随后从三个维度考察其充分性。

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Arrange). To what extent do LLM-generated tests cover the input boundary values relevant to a function? We propose Boundary-Value Adequacy (BVA), which statically extracts per-parameter obligations and assesses whether the generated tests cover them.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2（布局）。 LLM 生成的测试在多大程度上覆盖了与函数相关的输入边界值？ 我们提出边界值充分性（BVA），它静态地提取每个参数的义务，并评估生成的测试是否覆盖了这些义务。

sents.en: RQ2 (Arrange).
sents.zh: RQ2（布局）。

sents.en: To what extent do LLM-generated tests cover the input boundary values relevant to a function?
sents.zh: LLM 生成的测试在多大程度上覆盖了与函数相关的输入边界值？

sents.en: We propose Boundary-Value Adequacy (BVA), which statically extracts per-parameter obligations and assesses whether the generated tests cover them.
sents.zh: 我们提出边界值充分性（BVA），它静态地提取每个参数的义务，并评估生成的测试是否覆盖了这些义务。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Act). To what extent do LLM-generated tests adequately exercise the control-flow alternatives within a function? We propose Control-Flow Adequacy (CFA), which uses extreme-condition mutation to assess obligations associated with conditions, exception handlers, and switch cases.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3（行为）。 大语言模型生成的测试在多大程度上充分地覆盖了函数内的控制流分支？ 我们提出了控制流充分性（CFA），它使用极端条件变异来评估与条件、异常处理程序和 switch 分支相关联的义务。

sents.en: RQ3 (Act).
sents.zh: RQ3（行为）。

sents.en: To what extent do LLM-generated tests adequately exercise the control-flow alternatives within a function?
sents.zh: 大语言模型生成的测试在多大程度上充分地覆盖了函数内的控制流分支？

sents.en: We propose Control-Flow Adequacy (CFA), which uses extreme-condition mutation to assess obligations associated with conditions, exception handlers, and switch cases.
sents.zh: 我们提出了控制流充分性（CFA），它使用极端条件变异来评估与条件、异常处理程序和 switch 分支相关联的义务。

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (Assert). To what extent do LLM-generated tests verify a function’s outputs and exception behavior? We propose Oracle Strength (OS), which mutates return values and exception behavior and assesses whether the tests’ assertions detect these changes. We exclude incidental kills caused by unexpected exceptions or crashes from the killed-mutant count, so that these failures do not inflate the estimated strength of the test oracles.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4（断言）。 LLM生成的测试在多大程度上验证了函数的输出和异常行为？ 我们提出Oracle Strength（预言强度，OS），它对返回值和异常行为进行变异，并评估测试的断言是否能检测到这些变化。 我们将由意外异常或崩溃导致的偶然杀死从被杀死变异体的计数中排除，以使这些失败不会高估测试预言的估计强度。

sents.en: RQ4 (Assert).
sents.zh: RQ4（断言）。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we examine whether the observed blind spots also occur in less complex code:
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们检验所观察到的盲点是否也出现在复杂度较低的代码中：

paragraphs.en: RQ5 (Complexity). To what extent do the observed blind spots persist across levels of code complexity? We compare complex functions with a low-complexity control set to assess whether the identified gaps are concentrated in complex code or also occur in simpler functions.
paragraphs.zh: RQ5（复杂度）。 所观察到的盲点在不同代码复杂度层级上的持续程度如何？ 我们将复杂函数与低复杂度对照集进行比较，以评估所发现的差距是集中在复杂代码中，还是也会出现在较简单的函数中。

sents.en: RQ5 (Complexity).

sents.zh: 所观察到的盲点在不同代码复杂度层级上的持续程度如何？

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions we need a benchmark of real-world functions with known obligation profiles and a complexity-controlled comparison set. Existing benchmarks such as TestGenEval ( Jain et al., 2025 ) evaluate test generation quality using aggregate metrics but do not provide obligation-level annotations together with a complexity-stratified comparison set. We therefore introduce ObligBench, a Java benchmark derived from The Stack v2 ( Lozhkov et al., 2024 ) . It comprises 895 complex functions under test, selected from the top 5% by cyclomatic ( McCabe, 1976 ) and cognitive ( Campbell, 2018 ) complexity, and a low-complexity control set of 700 functions. In the main experiment, we evaluate four LLMs (GPT-5.4, Gemma-4-31B, Gemini-3.6-flash, and Qwen3-Coder-30B) under four prompting strategies (zero-shot, intention-planning, mutation-feedback, and Panta ( Gu et al., 2026 ) ) on the 895 complex functions, yielding 14,320 generated tests for RQ1-RQ4. For RQ5, we additionally evaluate tests generated for the 700-function low-complexity control set.
paragraphs.zh: 要回答这些问题，我们需要一个由具有已知义务特征的真实世界函数组成的基准，以及一个复杂度受控的对比集。 现有基准（如 TestGenEval（Jain et al., 2025））使用聚合指标评估测试生成质量，但既不提供义务级标注，也不提供按复杂度分层的对比集。 因此，我们提出了 ObligBench，这是一个源自 The Stack v2（Lozhkov et al., 2024）的 Java 基准。 它包含 895 个被测复杂函数，这些函数选自圈复杂度（McCabe, 1976）和认知复杂度（Campbell, 2018）排名前 5% 的函数，以及一个由 700 个函数组成的低复杂度对照集。 在主实验中，我们在 895 个复杂函数上评估了四个大语言模型（GPT-5.4、Gemma-4-31B、Gemini-3.6-flash 和 Qwen3-Coder-30B）在四种提示策略（零样本、意图规划、变异反馈和 Panta（Gu et al., 2026））下的表现，生成了 14,320 个测试，用于回答 RQ1-RQ4。 针对 RQ5，我们还对为 700 个函数的低复杂度对照集生成的测试进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Our results reveal systematic adequacy blind spots that aggregate coverage and mutation scores do not distinguish. LLM-generated tests struggle most with inputs requiring semantic reasoning about the function’s contract, as null inputs are covered in only 34.8% of applicable cases, negative inputs in 23.8%, and empty inputs in 38.8%. The same happy-path bias appears in control-flow adequacy, with scores of 0.100 for catch blocks and 0.312 for default groups, as reaching these constructs requires deliberately out-of-domain inputs that LLMs tend to avoid. Taken together, these patterns show that LLMs exhibit the happy-path bias long observed in human-written test suites ( Barr et al., 2015 ; Beller et al., 2015 ) that, attention is concentrated on normal inputs and expected execution flows, while unusual values and exceptional paths are systematically omitted, forming blind spots that aggregate metrics do not surface. On the assertion side, oracle strength is high overall but weak for object returns when concrete default mutation can be made, where models default to coarse checks rather than field-level value assertions. Section 6 presents the full results for all five research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果揭示了系统性的充分性盲区，这些盲区是聚合覆盖率和变异得分所无法区分的。 LLM 生成的测试在需要对函数契约进行语义推理的输入上表现最差：空值输入在适用用例中仅有 34.8% 被覆盖，负数输入为 23.8%，空输入为 38.8%。 同样的快乐路径偏差也出现在控制流充分性上，catch 块的得分为 0.100，default 分组的得分为 0.312，因为到达这些构造需要刻意设计的域外输入，而 LLM 往往会避开这类输入。 综合来看，这些模式表明 LLM 展现了在人工编写测试套件中早已被观察到的快乐路径偏差（Barr et al., 2015；Beller et al., 2015），即注意力集中于正常输入和预期执行流程，而异常值和异常路径被系统性地忽略，形成了聚合指标无法揭示的盲区。 在断言方面，测试预言强度总体较高，但在可以进行具体默认变异的对象返回值上较弱，此时模型倾向于采用粗粒度检查而非字段级的值断言。 第 6 节给出全部五个研究问题的完整结果。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based test generation. Automated unit test generation has a long history of search-based ( Harman and Jones, 2001 ; Fraser and Arcuri, 2011 ; Panichella et al., 2018 ) , random ( Pacheco et al., 2007 ) , and symbolic-execution ( King, 1976 ; Cadar et al., 2008 ) approaches. Anand et al. ( Anand et al., 2013 ) survey these methods before the emergence of LLM-based techniques. More recently, LLMs have become a prominent approach to test generation, both independently and in combination with established techniques. AthenaTest ( Tufano et al., 2020 ) formulates test generation as a sequence-to-sequence learning task, using pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning on focal-method–test pairs. ChatUniTest ( Chen et al., 2024 ) combines adaptive focal context with a generation-validation-repair workflow. TestPilot ( Schäfer et al., 2024 ) refines failing tests using execution errors, while CoverAgent ( CodiumAI, 2024 ) iteratively generates and validates tests to improve code coverage. CodaMosa ( Lemieux et al., 2023 ) invokes an LLM to overcome coverage plateaus in search-based generation. MuTAP ( Dakhel et al., 2024 ) uses surviving mutants to augment prompts for further test generation. ChatTester ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) combines intention-based generation with iterative repair guided by compilation errors and additional code context. Panta ( Gu et al., 2026 ) integrates static control-flow analysis and dynamic coverage feedback to identify under-tested execution paths and guide subsequent generation. In an industrial setting, Alshahwan et al. ( Alshahwan et al., 2024 ) introduce TestGen-LLM, which extends existing tests and filters generated candidates for build success, execution reliability, and coverage improvement. These approaches commonly assess effectiveness through compilation or execution success, structural coverage, or aggregate mutation scores. BlindSpotEval complements these measures with obligation-level profiles that distinguish adequacy across input categories, control-flow constructs, and assertion targets.

paragraphs.en: Test adequacy criteria. Structural criteria, including line coverage, branch coverage, and modified condition/decision coverage (MC/DC), assess the execution of code elements and satisfaction of decision-related coverage requirements ( Ammann and Offutt, 2016 ; Zhu et al., 1997 ) . Mutation testing introduces artificial faults and assesses whether tests detect the resulting changes ( DeMillo et al., 1978 ; Offutt and Untch, 2001 ; Jia and Harman, 2011 ; Coles et al., 2016 ; Tip et al., 2025 ) . Although both approaches provide detailed information, their aggregate scores do not directly distinguish adequacy across input categories, construct types, and assertion targets. Prior work examines limitations of structural coverage ( Goodenough and Gerhart, 1975 ; Inozemtseva and Holmes, 2014 ) , its relationship with mutation-based test generation ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2015 ) , and the detection of real faults by generated tests ( Shamshiri et al., 2015 ) . Other studies investigate whether mutation analysis reflects real-fault detection ( Andrews et al., 2005 ; Papadakis et al., 2018 ) . For LLM-generated tests, a replicability study finds that the usefulness of coverage and mutation scores depends on the evaluation setting ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 测试充分性准则。 结构准则（包括行覆盖、分支覆盖和修正条件/判定覆盖（MC/DC））评估代码元素的执行情况以及与判定相关的覆盖需求的满足程度（Ammann and Offutt, 2016; Zhu et al., 1997）。 变异测试引入人工缺陷，并评估测试是否能够检测到由此产生的变更（DeMillo et al., 1978; Offutt and Untch, 2001; Jia and Harman, 2011; Coles et al., 2016; Tip et al., 2025）。 尽管这两种方法都提供了详细信息，但它们的总体得分并不能直接区分不同输入类别、构造类型和断言目标之间的充分性。 已有的工作考察了结构覆盖的局限性（Goodenough and Gerhart, 1975; Inozemtseva and Holmes, 2014）、它与基于变异的测试生成之间的关系（Fraser and Arcuri, 2015），以及生成的测试对真实缺陷的检测能力（Shamshiri et al., 2015）。 另一些研究则考察变异分析是否能够反映真实缺陷的检测（Andrews et al., 2005; Papadakis et al., 2018）。 针对 LLM 生成的测试，一项可复现性研究发现，覆盖率和变异得分的有效性取决于评估环境（Zhao et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks for automated test generation. Established benchmarks such as SF110 ( Fraser and Arcuri, 2014 ) and Defects4J ( Just et al., 2014a ) support the evaluation of test generation and fault detection and predate the recent use of LLMs for these tasks. More recent benchmarks draw on repositories and curated code corpora. ULT ( Huang et al., 2025 ) provides curated function-level tasks involving complex Python functions, with an emphasis on mitigating test contamination. Its paired benchmark, PLT, supports comparisons with a setting in which reference tests are exposed. TestGenEval ( Jain et al., 2025 ) provides code–test file pairs for full-file test generation and test completion, evaluated through execution success, coverage, and mutation scores. Other benchmarks address related objectives. EvalPlus ( Liu et al., 2023 ) augments HumanEval with more extensive test inputs to evaluate the functional correctness of generated code, while SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) targets repository-level issue resolution. These resources do not jointly provide source-side obligation annotations and a complexity-stratified comparison set for evaluating generated unit tests. ObligBench provides both through real-world Java functions drawn from The Stack v2 ( Lozhkov et al., 2024 ) , complexity-based selection, and source-side obligation annotations. Its evaluation protocol requires function bodies to remain unchanged so that adequacy is assessed against a fixed implementation.

paragraphs.en: Existing test-generation benchmarks evaluate quality through aggregate metrics and do not jointly provide obligation-level annotations and a comparison set spanning different levels of complexity. To surface blind spots at the obligation level across all three AAA dimensions, we construct ObligBench from The Stack v2 ( Lozhkov et al., 2024 ) , a large licensed source-code corpus. We focus on Java because its explicit method signatures and mature analysis and testing ecosystem, including JaCoCo and PIT ( Coles et al., 2016 ) , support self-containment validation and obligation-level analysis. Adapting the multi-stage construction approach of ULT ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , we select functions under test (FUTs) by complexity, and validate both high-complexity and low-complexity sets for self-containment and leakage before generation as discussed below.

paragraphs.en: Complexity-guided non-trivial FUT selection. We select non-trivial FUTs using two complementary complexity metrics: (1) Cyclomatic complexity (CycC) ( McCabe, 1976 ) counts independent execution paths, and (2) cognitive complexity (CogC) ( Campbell, 2018 ) additionally penalizes nesting and flow interruptions. Together, these metrics capture different aspects of control-flow complexity and provide a basis for selecting functions with varied test-generation demands.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂度引导的非平凡FUT选择。 我们使用两种互补的复杂度度量来选择非平凡FUT：（1）圈复杂度（CycC）（McCabe, 1976）统计独立执行路径的数量，（2）认知复杂度（CogC）（Campbell, 2018）在此基础上额外惩罚嵌套和控制流中断。 这两种度量共同捕捉控制流复杂度的不同方面，为选择具有不同测试生成需求的函数提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: Self-containment. To enable test generation and execution without full repository context, we package each accepted function as an isolated executable Java task. The FUT body remains unchanged throughout this process, enforced by AST-token signature comparison against the original source. Each task passes a three-stage filter: parsing and type extraction, a smoke test that compiles the task and executes three distinct invocations, and an LLM wrapper-generation fallback for fixtures that fail to compile or execute.
paragraphs.zh: 自包含性。 为了在没有完整仓库上下文的情况下实现测试生成与执行，我们将每个被接受的函数打包为一个独立的可执行 Java 任务。 在整个过程中，被测函数（FUT）的方法体保持不变，这一点通过与原始源代码进行 AST-词法签名比对来强制保证。 每个任务都经过三阶段过滤：解析与类型提取；一项冒烟测试，对任务进行编译并执行三次不同的调用；以及针对无法编译或执行的样例的 LLM 包装器生成回退机制。

paragraphs.en: Test leakage check. Pre-existing tests in the corpus would give LLMs an unfair retrieval advantage ( Shi et al., 2024 ) . Following ULT ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , we check for existing tests associated with each FUT in the source corpus. We identify test-like files from the same Stack v2 repository and revision using path and content patterns, including /test/ , *Test.java , @Test , and common JUnit or TestNG imports. Our check is a deterministic filter over the hydrated cache, and we flag a candidate only if it references the focal method, class, or package with sufficient heuristic evidence. In ObligBench, no likely corresponding Stack v2 tests were found for any of the 895 unique tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 测试泄漏检查。 语料库中已有的测试会给大语言模型带来不公平的检索优势（Shi 等，2024）。 按照 ULT（Huang 等，2025）的做法，我们检查源语料库中是否存在与每个 FUT 相关的已有测试。 我们使用路径和内容模式，包括 /test/、*Test.java、@Test 以及常见的 JUnit 或 TestNG 导入，从同一个 Stack v2 仓库和修订版本中识别类测试文件。 我们的检查是在水合缓存之上进行的确定性过滤，只有当候选内容以足够的启发式证据引用了焦点方法、类或包时，才会将其标记出来。 在 ObligBench 中，针对全部 895 个唯一任务，均未发现可能对应的 Stack v2 测试。

paragraphs.en: Our research questions demand metrics that go beyond aggregate execution, coverage, and mutation scores. A test may execute successfully, cover branches, and kill mutants while still omitting important inputs, failing to check observable obligation, or asserting only coarse properties ( Barr et al., 2015 ; Hossain et al., 2023 ; Jahangirova et al., 2016 ) . Aggregate metrics summarize test performance but do not directly identify which behavioral obligations remain unchecked. We therefore define a set of deterministic adequacy metrics that characterize complementary dimensions of generated-test behavior and produce construct-level profiles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究问题需要超越聚合执行率、覆盖率和变异得分的度量指标。 一个测试可能执行成功、覆盖分支并杀死变异体，但仍然遗漏重要输入、未能检查可观察的义务，或仅断言粗粒度的属性（Barr 等，2015；Hossain 等，2023；Jahangirova 等，2016）。 聚合指标总结了测试的表现，但无法直接识别哪些行为义务仍未被检查。 因此，我们定义了一组确定性的充分性指标，用以刻画生成测试行为的互补维度，并产出构件级别的特征概貌。

paragraphs.en: The proposed metrics follow the Arrange-Act-Assert (AAA) structure commonly used to organize unit tests ( Osherove, 2014 ; Meszaros, 2007 ) . We measure Boundary-Value Adequacy (Section 4.3 ), which characterizes the inputs a test arranges; Control-Flow Adequacy (Section 4.4 ), which characterizes the behavioral branches the test reaches and distinguishes; and Oracle Strength (Section 4.5 ), which whether tests check return values and exception behavior through targeted mutations. Each metric is computed per generated test per FUT, and aggregate results are reported by model and prompting strategy. We refer to each test–FUT evaluation instance as a row .

paragraphs.en: The three metrics use different measurement procedures. BVA statically identifies selected input categories from the test source, independently of assertion quality. CFA and OS use targeted mutations and test execution to assess detection, and they are not independent: an obligation the test never reaches scores zero in CFA and is excluded from the OS denominator, so test suites with poor CFA may still have good OS. We report the eligible-obligation count alongside OS summary scores. We first describe the shared obligation scoring pipeline, then define each metric in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个指标采用不同的度量程序。 BVA 从测试源码中静态地识别所选的输入类别，不受断言质量的影响。 CFA 和 OS 使用针对性变异和测试执行来评估检测能力，且二者并不独立：测试从未到达的义务在 CFA 中得零分，并被排除在 OS 的分母之外，因此 CFA 较差的测试套件仍可能有较好的 OS。 我们在报告 OS 汇总分数的同时，一并报告合格义务的数量。 我们首先描述共享的义务评分流程，然后依次定义各个指标。

sents.en: CFA and OS use targeted mutations and test execution to assess detection, and they are not independent: an obligation the test never reaches scores zero in CFA and is excluded from the OS denominator, so test suites with poor CFA may still have good OS.
sents.zh: CFA 和 OS 使用针对性变异和测试执行来评估检测能力，且二者并不独立：测试从未到达的义务在 CFA 中得零分，并被排除在 OS 的分母之外，因此 CFA 较差的测试套件仍可能有较好的 OS。

sents.en: We report the eligible-obligation count alongside OS summary scores.
sents.zh: 我们在报告 OS 汇总分数的同时，一并报告合格义务的数量。

sents.en: We first describe the shared obligation scoring pipeline, then define each metric in turn.
sents.zh: 我们首先描述共享的义务评分流程，然后依次定义各个指标。

paragraphs.en: CFA and OS both score obligations by mutation: for each obligation, we construct mutants whose survival implies the obligation was not exercised or not checked. This differs from classical mutation testing, which reports a single aggregate kill count treating equivalent mutants as noise ( Papadakis et al., 2019 ) . Here, we score by the stage where obligation belongs (arrange, act or assert), and the corresponding obligation must be killed, incidental kills do no contribute the scores. Two design choices distinguish our scoring: mutants are attributed to individual obligations and scored per-obligation, and unrepresentable obligations are excluded from adequacy denominators, with CFA additionally reporting a representativeness rate to indicate tooling gaps.
paragraphs.zh: CFA 和 OS 都通过变异来为义务评分：对于每个义务，我们构造若干变异体，其存活即意味着该义务未被行使或未被检查。 这与经典的变异测试不同，后者报告一个单一的聚合杀死数，并将等价变异体视为噪声（ Papadakis et al., 2019 ）。 在这里，我们按义务所属的阶段（arrange、act 或 assert）进行评分，且对应的义务必须被杀死，偶然的杀死不计入评分。 两个设计选择使我们的评分与众不同：变异体被归属到各个义务并按义务逐一评分，无法表示的义务被排除在充分性分母之外，同时 CFA 还额外报告一个代表性比率以指示工具能力的缺口。

paragraphs.en: The CFA and OS scoring pipeline separates into two stages: (1) collectors generate mutants, compile and execute them, and write versioned artifacts, and (2) an analyzer consumes those artifacts and computes scores without rerunning mutations. paragraphs.en: Not every mutant kill indicates that the test deliberately verified the changed behavior: a mutant may also be killed by an unexpected exception, which is an incidental kill. To exclude incidental kills, we classify assertion failures ( AssertionError and its subtypes, including JUnit, OpenTest4J, and Mockito verification failures) as oracle kills, and all other escaping throwables as incidental. Incidental kills contribute zero to all scores. Moreover, an obligation the original test never reaches is excluded from OS and charged to CFA, and a mutant that could not be generated, failed to compile, or timed out reflects a tooling limitation and is excluded from adequacy denominators.
paragraphs.zh: 并非每一个被杀死的变异体都表明测试有意验证了被修改的行为：变异体也可能因一个意外的异常而被杀死，这属于偶然杀死。 为了排除偶然杀死，我们将断言失败（AssertionError 及其子类型，包括 JUnit、OpenTest4J 和 Mockito 的验证失败）归类为判定杀死，而将所有其他逃逸的可抛出对象归类为偶然杀死。 偶然杀死对所有得分的贡献为零。 此外，原始测试从未到达的义务不计入 OS，而计入 CFA；无法生成、编译失败或超时的变异体反映了工具的局限性，将从充分性分母中排除。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate generated tests in a regression-testing setting, treating the original FUT as the reference implementation. paragraphs.en: Compile failures arise when the test cannot be compiled due to private-field access, unresolved symbols, type mismatches, checked-exception violations, or syntax errors.
paragraphs.zh: 编译失败发生在测试因私有字段访问、未解析的符号、类型不匹配、受检异常违规或语法错误而无法编译时。

paragraphs.en: Execution failures arise when the test compiles but does not reach a clean end state. Subcategories include uncaught runtime exceptions and timeouts. We separately identify wrong-oracle failures , in which an assertion specifies an expected result inconsistent with the reference implementation. Line and branch coverage may still record the code executed before the assertion fails, so coverage scores alone do not establish whether the generated test passes.
paragraphs.zh: 当测试能够编译但未能达到干净的结束状态时，就会产生执行失败。 子类别包括未捕获的运行时异常和超时。 我们另外识别错误断言失败（wrong-oracle failures），即断言所指定的预期结果与参考实现不一致。 行覆盖率和分支覆盖率仍可能记录断言失败之前执行的代码，因此仅凭覆盖率分数无法确定生成的测试是否通过。

paragraphs.en: Signature-derived categories follow the declared type. Reference parameters receive a null obligation, strings and collections or arrays receive an empty obligation, numeric parameters receive zero and negative obligations, and boolean parameters receive obligations for both values. The inferred-bound categories are source-derived, each direct parameter–literal comparison in the FUT body, such as x < 5 , introduces below , at , and above obligations for that bound. Different inferred bounds are retained separately. String equality comparisons introduce an equality obligation for each inferred literal and a difference obligation requiring a value unequal to all inferred literals for that parameter. Boundary obligations are tracked separately for each parameter and each inferred bound. If a parameter is compared with multiple constants, each constant introduces its own boundary obligations.

paragraphs.en: We define Control-Flow Adequacy (CFA) to assesses whether tests adequately exercise control-flow alternatives, measuring whether generated tests check the behavioral alternatives selected by source-level control constructs. CFA measures whether changes in control-flow behavior is detectable by the generated tests, rather than execution coverage alone. A surviving mutant may indicate that the affected construct was not reached or that its changed behavior was not detected by the tests.

paragraphs.en: Branch coverage and standard mutation score both treat a test as adequate regardless of whether its assertions verify the exact resulting behavior. A test can achieve full branch coverage without asserting or asserting only that the function does not throw, leaving its actual result entirely unchecked. Even when meaningful assertions are present, kills can be incidental. A mutation may produce an unexpected exception and PIT records a kill, while the obligation was never intentionally checked. Oracle Strength (OS) addresses this blind spot by scoring each assertion obligation via targeted mutation that isolates changes to the asserted value. For each supported obligation, we generate a mutant using a deterministic rule and observe the test outcome. The obligation is checked when the mutant is killed through an oracle under the classification rules below. A surviving mutant or an incidental failure receives zero credit.

paragraphs.en: All experiments use ObligBench (Section 3 ), comprising 895 treatment functions under test (FUT) and a 700-task low-complexity control set. Each generated test is evaluated in an isolated Maven Java 17 task project. Tests are first compiled and executed, executable tests are then evaluated using PIT mutation score and the three adequacy metrics defined in Section 4 . Non-executable tests are retained for failure analysis (Section 6.1 ) but excluded from adequacy-score averages. The treatment set provides 14,320 test–FUT rows for RQ1-RQ4, while the control set is used only for the complexity comparison in RQ5.

paragraphs.en: We compare four generation strategies. All receive the same function-under-test source code and benchmark metadata, and produce JUnit 5 test files under a shared execution contract.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了四种生成策略。 所有策略接收相同的被测函数源代码和基准测试元数据，并在共享的执行契约下生成 JUnit 5 测试文件。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot. The zero-shot strategy generates a complete JUnit 5 test file from function source and task metadata alone, without examples, planning, repair, or mutation feedback. It serves as the simplest baseline, measuring what the model produces from source code alone.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本。 零样本策略仅根据函数源代码和任务元数据生成完整的 JUnit 5 测试文件，不使用示例、规划、修复或变异反馈。 它是最简单的基线，用于衡量模型仅凭源代码能产出什么。

paragraphs.en: Intention-planning. Inspired by plan-and-generate approaches ( Tufano et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ryan et al., 2024 ) , intention-planning separates test planning from implementation , the model first produces a structured plan covering target behavior, inputs, branch cases, and exception conditions, then generates the test file using both the plan and source code. This makes intended obligations explicit before code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 意图规划。 受“先规划后生成”方法（Tufano et al., 2020; Chen et al., 2024; Ryan et al., 2024）的启发，意图规划将测试规划与实现分离：模型先生成一个涵盖目标行为、输入、分支情况和异常条件的结构化规划，然后结合该规划和源代码生成测试文件。 这使得预期义务在代码生成之前得以显式化。

sents.en: Intention-planning.

paragraphs.en: Mutation-feedback. Mutation-feedback extends intention-planning with one feedback round, after the initial test is executed, surviving PIT mutants are summarized as a compact feedback object that the model uses to improve the test ( Dakhel et al., 2024 ; CodiumAI, 2024 ) . We bound the strategy to a single feedback round to keep conditions comparable across models. 1 1 1 MuTAP ( Dakhel et al., 2024 ) and ChatTester ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) are natural candidates for direct comparison but could not be integrated, as their harnesses are tightly coupled to specific model APIs (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) with fixed structured-output contracts incompatible with our pipeline. Reimplementing them would conflate harness design with prompt-strategy differences, we instead capture their mutation-evidence-as-feedback principle in our mutation-feedback strategy under a shared execution contract.
paragraphs.zh: 变异反馈。 变异反馈在意图规划的基础上增加了一轮反馈：在初始测试执行之后，存活的 PIT 变异体被汇总为一个紧凑的反馈对象，模型利用该对象来改进测试（Dakhel 等，2024；CodiumAI，2024）。 我们将该方法限定为单轮反馈，以保持各模型之间的条件可比性。111 MuTAP（Dakhel 等，2024）和 ChatTester（Yuan 等，2024）是直接比较的天然候选，但无法集成，因为它们的测试框架与特定模型 API（GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4）紧密耦合，其固定的结构化输出约定与我们的流水线不兼容。 重新实现它们会把测试框架设计与提示策略差异混为一谈，因此我们改为在共享的执行约定下，通过我们的变异反馈策略来体现它们「以变异证据作为反馈」的原则。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all four strategies using GPT-5.4 (OpenAI, proprietary large), Gemma-4-31B (RedHatAI, open-weight mid), Gemini-3.6-flash (Google DeepMind, proprietary lightweight), and Qwen3-Coder-30B (Alibaba, open-weight code-specialist). The suite includes proprietary models from OpenAI and Google, an open-weight Gemma checkpoint distributed by RedHatAI, and an open-weight coding model from Alibaba’s Qwen family. These models provide variation in model family, accessibility, and specialization. For RQ5, we select GPT-5.4 and Gemma-4-31B as the highest and lowest performers in the suite, bracketing the capability range across the proprietary/open-weight divide. Qwen is excluded due to its elevated failure rate under guided strategies, while Gemini-3.6-flash, as a lightweight intermediate-tier model, would not meaningfully extend this contrast.

paragraphs.en: [Objective and design]: Successful compilation and execution are prerequisites for the adequacy analyses in RQ2–RQ4. This RQ therefore examine how often LLM-generated tests compile and run successfully, and characterizes the failures that occur. The experiment covers 895 treatment FUTs, four LLMs, and four generation strategies, yielding 14,320 test–FUT rows (Section 5 ). We record two success rates, compilation success and execution success , and classify failed tests using the categories defined in Section 4.2 . Furthermore, we record the generation failure specially for Panta when it produces a placeholder stub instead of a test. Only successfully executed, non-placeholder tests proceed to adequacy analysis in RQ2-RQ4.
paragraphs.zh: [目标与设计]：成功编译和执行是RQ2–RQ4中充分性分析的前提条件。 因此，本RQ考察LLM生成的测试成功编译和运行的概率，并对出现的失败进行刻画。 该实验涵盖895个处理FUT、四个LLM和四种生成策略，共产生14,320条测试–FUT记录（见第5节）。 我们记录两个成功率，即编译成功率和执行成功率，并使用第4.2节中定义的类别对失败的测试进行分类。 此外，我们专门记录Panta在生成占位符存根而非测试时的生成失败。 只有成功执行的非占位符测试才会进入RQ2–RQ4的充分性分析。

paragraphs.en: [Results]: Of the 14,320 generated-test rows, 10,329 (72.1%) are eligible for adequacy analysis. These correspond to 10.0%, 9.7%, 7.5%, and 0.7% of all generated-test rows, demonstrating that LLMs are generally capable of generating compilable and runnable unit tests. paragraphs.en: [Objective and design]: Coverage and mutation scores reveal how much of the FUT a test suite reaches, but not whether its inputs include the boundary values most likely to expose faults, such as null , negative , or empty arguments. This RQ therefore measures how well LLM-generated tests cover the boundary values each FUT is designed to handle, corresponding to the Arrange phase of the AAA pattern. From RQ2 to RQ4, we always evaluate the tests eligible after RQ1, using the same four LLMs under the same four generation strategies. For each FUT, we extract parameter-specific boundary obligations (Section 4.3 ) and check which of them the tests cover. We report boundary-value adequacy (BVA) by boundary category, model, and prompting strategy.
paragraphs.zh: [目标与设计]：覆盖率和变异得分反映测试套件触达被测函数（FUT）的程度，但无法说明其输入是否包含最有可能暴露缺陷的边界值，例如 null、负数或空参数。 因此，本研宄问题（RQ）衡量 LLM 生成的测试对每个被测函数（FUT）设计所要处理的边界值的覆盖程度，这对应 AAA 模式中的 Arrange 阶段。 从 RQ2 到 RQ4，我们始终评估经 RQ1 筛选后合格的测试，并使用相同的四个 LLM 和相同的四种生成策略。 对于每个被测函数（FUT），我们提取与参数相关的边界义务（第 4.3 节），并检查测试覆盖了其中的哪些义务。 我们按边界类别、模型和提示策略报告边界值充分性（BVA）。

paragraphs.en: [Results]: Figure 1 shows substantial variation across boundary categories. Boolean obligations achieve high coverage, averaging 93.13% for true and 93.75% for false . The different_inferred_bound category reaches 100% across all model–strategy combinations. By contrast, negative , null , and empty obligations have coverage of only 23.8%, 34.8%, and 38.8%. paragraphs.en: The BVA score asymmetry reveals a fundamental divide in how LLMs reason about test inputs, the generated tests more consistently include inputs with explicit alternatives or source-level cues. For high-coverage categories, there is usually straightforward specification in the source code about what to test. Boolean boundary values are simply true and false, while the different_inferred_bound is derived from string literals appearing in equality comparisons. However, the low-coverage categories require explicit selection of null references, negative numbers, or empty values, and non-trivial reasoning is required for LLMs to understand what boundary value needs to be covered. Although their applicability can be identified from parameter types, these input boundaries do not appear explicitly in the implementation. In our result, null handling is not specified by the declared type alone, negative requires hypothesising a domain violation on numeric inputs, and empty requires actively constructing a degenerate collection or string rather than the non-empty defaults models prefer. Their low coverage is consistent with a preference for ordinary inputs over boundary and exceptional cases.
paragraphs.zh: BVA 得分的不对称性揭示了大型语言模型在推理测试输入时的根本分歧，生成的测试更一致地包含具有显式备选项或源码级线索的输入。 对于高覆盖类别，源代码中通常有关于测试什么的直接明确的规范。 布尔边界值就是 true 和 false，而 different_inferred_bound 则来自出现在相等比较中的字符串字面量。 然而，低覆盖类别需要显式地选择空引用、负数或空值，大语言模型需要经过非平凡的推理才能理解需要覆盖哪个边界值。 尽管它们的适用性可以从参数类型中识别出来，但这些输入边界并没有在实现中显式出现。 在我们的结果中，空值处理并非仅由声明的类型决定，负数需要在数值输入上假设域违规，而空值则需要主动构造一个退化的集合或字符串，而不是模型偏好的非空默认值。 它们的低覆盖率与模型偏好普通输入而非边界和异常情况的倾向相一致。

paragraphs.en: [Objective and design]: Aggregate branch coverage reports how many branches a test suite reaches, but not which kinds of behavior remain unexercised, such as exception-handling paths or default cases. This RQ therefore measures how thoroughly LLM-generated tests exercise the control-flow alternatives, corresponding to the Act phase of the AAA pattern. We evaluate eligible tests using the obligation-level mutations defined in Section 4.4 and report CFA by construct, model, and prompting strategy. We also compare representativeness and detection scores with PIT-based measurements to assess the additional construct-level information provided by our operators.
paragraphs.zh: [目标与设计]：聚合分支覆盖率反映测试套件到达了多少分支，但无法说明哪些类型的行为仍未被执行，例如异常处理路径或默认情况。 因此，本 RQ 衡量 LLM 生成的测试对控制流备选路径的覆盖彻底程度，对应 AAA 模式中的 Act 阶段。 我们使用 4.4 节中定义的义务级变异对合格测试进行评估，并按构造、模型和提示策略报告 CFA。 我们还将代表性得分和检测得分与基于 PIT 的度量进行比较，以评估我们的算子所提供的额外构造级信息。

paragraphs.en: [Results]: Table 7 compares our proposed mutation operator and PIT on Representative rate and Adequacy score . The table reveals differences between the approaches. First, the our mutation operators represent substantially more obligations for several constructs, particularly explicit throw statements. Second, PIT kill rates far exceed our CFA adequacy scores, making a PIT-only evaluation systematically overconfident. Since PIT represents a smaller subset of obligations, its scores may omit inadequately tested constructs that our operators include.
paragraphs.zh: [结果]：表 7 从代表性比率（Representative rate）和充分性得分（Adequacy score）两方面比较了我们提出的变异算子与 PIT。 该表揭示了两种方法之间的差异。 首先，我们的变异算子对若干构造表示出了多得多的义务，尤其是显式 throw 语句。 其次，PIT 的杀死率远高于我们的 CFA 充分性得分，这使得仅使用 PIT 的评估会系统性地过于自信。 由于 PIT 只表示一个更小的义务子集，其得分可能遗漏我们的算子所包含的测试不充分的构造。

paragraphs.en: Representativeness across constructs. CFA Repr. and PIT Repr. expose how well each tool can generate mutants for obligations. Our obligation-level operators achieve 78.1–99.5% representativeness across constructs, while the configured PIT operators represent only 44.7–45.3% of catch and default obligations and 1.4% of explicit throw obligations. paragraphs.en: [Objective and design]: Coverage score showing a return or exception line is reached does not establish that its behavior is meaningfully checked. Assertions may constrain only coarse properties, and unexpected execution failures can receive mutant-kill credit incidentally. This RQ therefore measures how effectively LLM-generated tests check the FUT’s return values and exception behaviors, corresponding to the Assert phase of the AAA pattern. For each FUT, we mutate its return values and exception obligations (Section 4.5 ) and check whether the tests’ assertions detect the change, excluding incidental kills from unexpected throws and crashes. We report OS over reached obligations with eligible mutants, broken down by return category and exception behavior across models and prompting strategies.
paragraphs.zh: [目标与设计]：覆盖得分显示某条返回或异常代码行被执行到，并不能说明其行为得到了有意义的检查。 断言可能只约束了粗糙的属性，而意外的执行失败也可能顺带获得杀死变异体的得分。 因此，本 RQ 衡量 LLM 生成的测试检查被测函数（FUT）返回值与异常行为的有效程度，对应 AAA 模式中的 Assert（断言）阶段。 对每个 FUT，我们对其返回值和异常义务（第 4.5 节）进行变异，并检查测试的断言能否检测出该变化，同时排除由意外抛出和崩溃导致的偶然杀死。 我们针对已达成的、存在合格变异体的义务报告 OS，并按返回类别和异常行为在不同模型与提示策略下进行细分。

paragraphs.en: [Results]: Return obligations. Figure 3 shows that boolean obligations score highest at 0.899, followed by enum/class tokens at 0.868 and strings at 0.862. Boolean, enum/class-token, and string results can often be checked directly through some limited set of value or equality assertions. paragraphs.en: [Objective and design]: The preceding results identify recurring adequacy gaps in complex functions. This RQ examines whether similar gaps also occur in simpler code. Control functions fall below both complexity thresholds defined in Section 3 . paragraphs.en: We propose BlindSpotEval , an obligation-based evaluation framework for LLM-generated unit tests, evaluating tests through Boundary-Value Adequacy, Control-Flow Adequacy, and Oracle Strength, complemented by execution reliability and failure-mode analysis. We also introduce ObligBench , a complexity-stratified Java benchmark of 895 complex and 700 low complexity FUTs with source-side obligation annotations. Applied to 14,320 generated tests across four LLMs and four prompting strategies on ObligBench treatment set, BlindSpotEval reveals systematic blind spots that aggregate coverage and mutation scores do not distinguish.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 BlindSpotEval，一个面向 LLM 生成单元测试的基于义务的评估框架，通过边界值充分性、控制流充分性和预言机强度来评估测试，并辅以执行可靠性和失效模式分析。 我们还引入 ObligBench，一个按复杂度分层的 Java 基准，包含 895 个高复杂度和 700 个低复杂度的 FUT，并带有源代码侧的义务标注。 将其应用于 ObligBench 治理集上四个 LLM 和四种提示策略生成的 14,320 个测试，BlindSpotEval 揭示了聚合覆盖率和变异分数无法区分的系统性盲点。

paragraphs.en: Execution reliability is the first barrier, with 72.1% of generated-test rows eligible for adequacy analysis. Wrong-oracle failures account for 15.6% of excluded rows, demonstrating that executed code can receive coverage credit even when generated assertions fail. Beyond execution, the dominant weakness is out-of-domain value reasoning and bias to happy path. Boolean and inferred-bound BVA categories are near-ceiling across all models and strategies, whereas null , negative , and empty obligations reach only 34.8%, 23.8%, and 38.8%, for which the boundary values are not directly inferrable from the source code. These omissions, together with low CFA for catch blocks (0.100) and default groups (0.312), are consistent with a happy-path preference in generated tests.
paragraphs.zh: 执行可靠性是首要障碍，72.1% 的生成测试行有资格进行充分性分析。 错误预言机（wrong-oracle）失败占被排除行的 15.6%，这表明即使生成的断言失败，已执行的代码仍可获得覆盖计分。 在执行之外，主要的弱点是领域外值推理和偏向正常路径（happy path）。 布尔值和推断边界的 BVA 类别在所有模型和策略上都接近上限，而 null、负数和空值义务分别仅达到 34.8%、23.8% 和 38.8%，这些边界值无法直接从源代码推断出来。 这些遗漏，连同 catch 块（0.100）和默认分支（0.312）的低 CFA，与生成测试中的正常路径偏好相一致。

paragraphs.en: Obligation-based control-flow mutations broaden construct-level evaluation, particularly for explicit throw obligations, which achieve 98.2% representativeness compared with 1.4% under the configured PIT analysis. Separate forced-outcome mutations also distinguish partial checking of conditional alternatives that an any-kill indicator does not express. Oracle Strength further distinguishes meaningful checking from incidental execution failures. Although return obligations score 0.842 overall, concrete-constructor-defaults obligations score only 0.325, exposing a pronounced gap in detecting changes to constructed object state. Exception obligations score 0.625, further distinguishing the ability to reach exceptional behavior from the ability to check it.
paragraphs.zh: 基于义务的控制流变异扩展了构造级别的评估，特别是对于显式抛出义务，其代表性达到 98.2%，而在配置的 PIT 分析下仅为 1.4%。 单独的强制结果变异还能区分条件分支的部分检查，这是 any-kill 指标无法表达的。 Oracle Strength 进一步将有意义的检查与偶然的执行失败区分开来。 尽管返回义务总体得分为 0.842，但具体构造函数默认值的义务得分仅为 0.325，暴露出在检测被构造对象状态变更方面的显著差距。 异常义务得分为 0.625，进一步将到达异常行为的能力与检查异常行为的能力区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The low-complexity comparison shows that selected boundary-value and control-flow blind spots also occur in simpler functions, while well-supported OS categories remain strongly checked across both complexity sets. Across the study, obligation-level profiles identify the input categories, control-flow constructs, and observable behaviors that require stronger testing.
paragraphs.zh: 低复杂度对比表明，所选的边界值与控制流盲区也出现在较简单的函数中，而在两种复杂度集合中，支持良好的操作系统类别仍然得到充分检查。 在整个研究中，义务级画像识别出需要更强测试的输入类别、控制流结构和可观察行为。

sents.en: Across the study, obligation-level profiles identify the input categories, control-flow constructs, and observable behaviors that require stronger testing.

paragraphs.en: Together, these findings motivate shifting from aggregate coverage and mutation scores to construct-level adequacy profiles that reveal where generated tests leave behavioral obligations unchecked and guide targeted improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些发现促使我们从聚合的覆盖率和变异得分转向构造级别的充分性画像，这种画像能够揭示生成的测试在哪些行为义务上仍未得到检验，并指导有针对性的改进。
